content.rendered:
Happy Summer Ridges Families! 

We’ve been watching the forecast carefully and it looks like Wednesday is going to be much too warm to host an outdoor play date for our incoming kindergarten students. We wanted to make sure families had ample time to plan, so we are going to reschedule the July 16th playdate to Monday, July 21st from 4-5 pm. We will plan to meet behind the school on the Edy side playground (the larger playground near the portable buildings). 

If you are unable to make our playdate on Monday, July 21st, we will also be hosting a morning playdate in August on the 12th from 10-11 am. 

Hope to see you next week,

Miranda
